Title: Content Security Policy Blocks Google Fonts Stylesheet Globally
ActualBehavior: CSP blocks fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet on every page load with console error
ExpectedBehavior: Brand typography (IBM Plex Sans Arabic & IBM Plex Mono) should load cleanly without CSP violation
UserImpact: Platform falls back to generic system fonts causing typography degradation and line-height shifts
RootCause: Next.js CSP header omits https://fonts.googleapis.com from style-src and https://fonts.gstatic.com from font-src
RecommendedCorrection: Add https://fonts.googleapis.com to style-src and https://fonts.gstatic.com to font-src in headers configuration

Title: Unauthenticated Pricing Page Renders Skeletons and Emits 401 Error
ActualBehavior: Shows 4 loading skeleton cards for 300-1000ms while fetching protected /api/subscription then falls back to static plans after 401 error
ExpectedBehavior: Public visitor should immediately see static package catalog SSR/SSG without skeleton flicker or 401 console error
UserImpact: Perceived latency layout shift and smoke test assertion flakiness on initial load
RootCause: Page initializes loading=true and unconditionally calls protected /api/subscription on client mount
RecommendedCorrection: Initialize loading=false when no auth session cookie is present and render static plans immediately

Title: Score Lab Switches Missing Accessible Names (WCAG 4.1.2)
ActualBehavior: Interactive switch buttons in Score Lab have no aria-label text or aria-labelledby association
ExpectedBehavior: Each switch should have an accessible name indicating which scoring rule is being toggled
UserImpact: Screen reader users hear unlabeled button / switch with no context on what rule it controls
RootCause: ScoreLab.tsx switch buttons lack aria-label or aria-labelledby attributes
RecommendedCorrection: Add aria-labelledby referencing rule label ID or explicit aria-label on all Score Lab switches

Title: Developer Analytics Range Select Dropdown Missing Accessible Label (WCAG 4.1.2)
ActualBehavior: Select element rendered without associated label or aria-label
ExpectedBehavior: Dropdown must have visible label or aria-label identifying the cohort/metric range
UserImpact: Screen reader users cannot identify what period or metric range is being selected
RootCause: Select component rendered without label prop or aria-label in /dashboard/analytics
RecommendedCorrection: Add aria-label="الفترة الزمنية / Time Range" or visible label to Select element

Title: Admin Quality Batch Verification Number Input Missing Accessible Label (WCAG 4.1.2)
ActualBehavior: Number input has no associated label or aria-label
ExpectedBehavior: Number input must have accessible label identifying batch size
UserImpact: Screen reader users cannot determine what the number input represents
RootCause: Input element has min/max/type but lacks id/label association or aria-label
RecommendedCorrection: Add aria-label="حجم دفعة التوثيق / Batch Verification Size" to number input

Title: Horizontal Overflow and Layout Shift on Living Style Guide Table on Mobile
ActualBehavior: Document scrollWidth (393px) exceeds clientWidth (390px) creating horizontal scrollbar
ExpectedBehavior: Tables and wide components should be wrapped in overflow-x-auto to prevent document overflow
UserImpact: Horizontal wobbling and broken mobile viewport margins on /design-system
RootCause: Unwrapped preview table without overflow container on narrow viewports
RecommendedCorrection: Wrap design system table in div with overflow-x-auto and max-w-full

Title: Admin Matching Page Backend Gaps (404 on /config and /debug) and Blank Constraints Tab
ActualBehavior: /api/admin/matching/config and /debug return 404; Config tab renders completely blank
ExpectedBehavior: Config tab should display matching policies and Debugger should return pairwise eligibility evaluation
UserImpact: Admin cannot inspect matching constraints or debug rule failures; UI fails silently with 404 errors
RecommendedCorrection: Implement missing API endpoints or provide client fallback state with informative banner

Title: Login and Register Form Fields Lack Standard Autocomplete Attributes
ActualBehavior: Email and password inputs lack autocomplete attributes emitting browser console warnings
ExpectedBehavior: Inputs should declare autoComplete="email" autoComplete="current-password" or autoComplete="new-password"
UserImpact: Password managers and browser autofill fail to suggest stored credentials creating login friction
RootCause: Input components lack explicit autoComplete prop on auth forms
RecommendedCorrection: Add autoComplete props to email and password fields in login and register pages

Title: Missing Password Visibility Toggle on Authentication Screens
ActualBehavior: Password inputs lack toggle to reveal plain text
ExpectedBehavior: Users should be able to toggle password visibility to verify complex credentials
UserImpact: Increased login failures and typos especially on mobile touch keyboards
RootCause: Password inputs rendered as fixed type="password" without toggle button
RecommendedCorrection: Add Show/Hide password toggle button inside password input container

Title: Absence of Self-Service Password Recovery Link on Login Screen
ActualBehavior: Login page has no "Forgot Password" or recovery link
ExpectedBehavior: Login page should provide a clear path for locked-out users to recover or reset passwords
UserImpact: Users who forget passwords have no self-service path and cannot regain platform access
RootCause: No password recovery route or link exists in the current authentication UI
RecommendedCorrection: Add "نسيت كلمة المرور؟ / Forgot password?" link with support modal or recovery request flow

Title: Empty Filter State in Leads Discovery Lacks One-Click Reset Action
ActualBehavior: Displays empty state text but requires manual clearing of each individual dropdown filter
ExpectedBehavior: Empty state should provide a single primary button to "إعادة ضبط جميع الفلاتر / Reset all filters"
UserImpact: Friction and extra clicks required when user searches for a term with no matches
RootCause: EmptyState component on /leads does not pass action prop to reset filter state

Title: Deal Timeline in Lead Details Lacks Historical Status Event Stream
ActualBehavior: Timeline displays only client-submitted notes and lacks chronological system status transitions
ExpectedBehavior: Timeline should show chronological progression (Claimed -> Contacted -> Meeting -> Won)
UserImpact: Developers cannot review lifecycle history or audit trail of interactions on their claimed deals
RootCause: Backend /api/leads/[id] does not aggregate engagement and claim audit logs into events stream
RecommendedCorrection: Expand /api/leads/[id] to return unified events array combining notes and stage transitions

Title: Irreversible Lead Invalidation Lacks Explicit Warning Confirmation Dialog
ActualBehavior: Selecting INVALID status immediately transitions lead and initiates refund dispute without confirmation
ExpectedBehavior: Consequential action should display confirmation dialog explaining dispute consequences
UserImpact: Accidental selection can invalidate active leads and initiate unintended disputes
RootCause: Status change handler triggers immediate patch request without modal confirmation guard
RecommendedCorrection: Introduce confirmation dialog when developer selects terminal or dispute statuses (INVALID)

Title: Cramped Tablet Header Layout with Co-located Chips and Logo at 768px
ActualBehavior: Top bar maintains desktop spacing while hamburger menu drawer appears crowding header items
ExpectedBehavior: Tablet breakpoint should adjust padding and hide secondary breadcrumbs/chips
UserImpact: Cluttered appearance on iPad viewports where brand wordmark and chips compete for space
RootCause: TopBar.tsx lacks intermediate breakpoint responsive classes for tablet widths
RecommendedCorrection: Add md:max-w-xs or responsive hidden classes to non-essential breadcrumbs at 768px

Title: Redundant "0 EGP per point" Caption on Free Plan Package Card
ActualBehavior: PackageCard displays "حوالي 0 ج.م للنقطة / Approx. 0 EGP per point" on free plan
ExpectedBehavior: Free plan should display "مجاناً / Free" rather than calculating per-point cost on zero price
UserImpact: Minor cognitive awkwardness and unnecessary arithmetic displayed to prospective customers
RootCause: PackageCard pricePerPoint calculation executes unconditionally even when priceEGP is 0
RecommendedCorrection: Conditionally suppress pricePerPoint caption when priceEGP is 0 and render "مجاناً / Free"

Title: Keyboard Navigation Does Not Trigger Hero Lead Card Field Highlighting
ActualBehavior: Hovering "Why 85?" reasons highlights fields visually but keyboard focus on triggers does not
ExpectedBehavior: Focusing reason items via keyboard should trigger the same highlight ring as mouse hover
UserImpact: Keyboard-only users do not experience the interactive rule-to-field correspondence
RootCause: Highlighting event listener attached to onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave without onFocus/onBlur
RecommendedCorrection: Add onFocus and onBlur handlers to mirror hover state on activeReasonIndex

Title: User Account Locale Choice Stored Only in Browser Cookie Not User Record
ActualBehavior: Changing language sets lf_locale cookie but does not sync to database user record
ExpectedBehavior: User profile should persist preferredLocale in database across device logins
UserImpact: Switching devices resets user to platform default language (Arabic) until manually toggled
RootCause: User Prisma model lacks preferredLocale field (documented in BACKEND_GAPS.md)
RecommendedCorrection: Add preferredLocale field to User model and synchronize cookie upon login

Title: Frequent Skeleton Flash on Internal Admin Navigation Between Tabs
ActualBehavior: Switching between admin tabs always causes full-table skeleton flashes due to un-cached fetches
ExpectedBehavior: Admin dashboard should retain previous tab data or use optimistic transitions for smoother UX
UserImpact: Visual disruption and perceived sluggishness during administrative workflows
RootCause: Client components fetch on mount without client-side cache or SWR/React Query caching
RecommendedCorrection: Implement lightweight in-memory cache or stale-while-revalidate for admin list queries
